method: Shortest paths through person-like nodes and sourced claim endpoints. Source nodes, place nodes and text nodes do not count as person links. Direction is ignored for reachability, not for interpretation. Identity hypotheses excluded. A path does not establish meetings, contemporaneity or a single historical Agastya.
